fusions.name: Ride-By Snatch
fusions.desc: Leans from the saddle to snatch at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 25% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Trampling Pass
fusions.desc: Rides through a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have travelled (max +25%).

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Faithful Mount
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded heidel that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. Each kill returns 3 health.
